question: The Pope declared Mother Teresa 'Saint' in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mother Teresa was declared a saint by **Pope Francis on September 4, 2016.**
 
• **Born on August 26, 1910, in Skopje**, which is now in North Macedonia it was part of the Ottoman Empire at the time.
 
• Mother Teresa began her work in the slums of **Kolkata (then Calcutta), India, in 1948.**
 
• Mother Teresa received the **Nobel Peace Prize in 1979** for her humanitarian work.
 
• Aside from the Nobel Peace Prize, Mother Teresa received **Bharat Ratna in 1980, and Padma Shri in 1962**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mother Teresa **passed away** on September 5, 1997, in Kolkata at the age of 87.
 
• She was **canonized as Saint Teresa** of Calcutta by Pope Francis on September 4, 2016, in a ceremony at the **Vatican**.
 
• Mother Teresa **was beatified by Pope John Paul II in 2003**, a major step towards sainthood.
 
• She opened the **Nirmal Hriday (Pure Heart)** home for dying people in Kolkata in 1952.
 
• The Pope is the **Bishop of Rome** and the leader of the worldwide Catholic Church.
 
• He is considered the spiritual **successor to Saint Peter**, one of the 12 apostles of Jesus, who is** believed to be the first Pope.**
 
• **Pope Francis (born Jorge Mario Bergoglio)** is the 266th Pope and was elected on March 13, 2013.
 
• The Pope's **official insignia** includes the Papal Tiara, the Keys of Heaven, and the Fisherman's Ring.
